questions.question: Are there an equal number of small green matte objects and big green metallic cubes?
questions.query:
MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects>
 WITH collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o{size:'small',color:'green',material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o IN objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o2:cube{size:'large',color:'green',material:'metal'}>
 WHERE o2 IN objects
 RETURN count(DISTINCT o)=count(DISTINCT o2)

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects
 MATCH <o:cylinder{size:'large',color:'gray',material:'metal'}>~[:left]~~<o2{material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 MATCH <o3:cylinder{size:'large'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 RETURN o2.color=o3.color AS same

questions.question: Does the large blue metal object have the same shape as the red object right of the purple block?

questions.question: What number of cylinders are large objects or tiny purple things?

questions.question: How many objects are small yellow cylinders to the right of the tiny brown matte cube or green cylinders?

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:cube{size:'small',color:'brown',material:'rubber'}>~[:right]~~<o2:cylinder{size:'small',color:'yellow'}>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 WITH i,objects,o2
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o3:cylinder{color:'green'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 WITH collect( distinct o2) + collect(distinct o3) AS all unwind all as a  RETURN count( distinct a)

questions.question: There is a big matte object that is right of the big purple cylinder; is it the same shape as the yellow matte object?

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects
 MATCH <o:cylinder{size:'large',color:'purple'}>~[:right]~~<o2{size:'large',material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 MATCH <o3{color:'yellow',material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 RETURN labels(o2)[0]=labels(o3)[0] AS same

questions.question: Is the number of rubber cubes behind the small cyan thing the same as the number of small metallic balls?
questions.query:
MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects>
 WITH collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o{size:'small',color:'cyan'}>~[:behind]~~<o2:cube{material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o3:sphere{size:'small',material:'metal'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 RETURN count(DISTINCT o2)=count(DISTINCT o3)

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects>
 WITH collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:sphere{size:'small',color:'yellow'}>~[:left]~~<o2:sphere>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o3{color:'red',material:'rubber'}>~[:right]~~<o4{color:'yellow'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects AND o4 IN objects
 RETURN count(DISTINCT o2)>count(DISTINCT o4)

questions.question: How many big objects are in front of the big cube and to the right of the large cyan shiny sphere?

 WITH collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o{color:'gray',material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o IN objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o2:sphere{size:'small'}>
 WHERE o2 IN objects
 RETURN count(DISTINCT o)<count(DISTINCT o2)

questions.question: There is a small rubber thing that is the same color as the large rubber thing; what is its shape?

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects
 MATCH <o{size:'large',color:'gray',material:'metal'}>~[:right]~~<o2:sphere>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 MATCH <o3:sphere{material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 RETURN o2.color=o3.color AS same

questions.question: Are there fewer yellow cylinders than large cylinders?
questions.query:
MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects>
 WITH collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:cylinder{color:'yellow'}>
 WHERE o IN objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o2:cylinder{size:'large'}>
 WHERE o2 IN objects
 RETURN count(DISTINCT o)<count(DISTINCT o2)

questions.question: Is the number of gray cylinders that are behind the blue metal ball the same as the number of yellow shiny cylinders?

questions.question: What number of spheres are on the left side of the large brown object and on the right side of the tiny red thing?
questions.query: MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects MATCH <o{size:'small',color:'red'}>~[:right]~~<o3:sphere>~~[:left]~<o2{size:'large',color:'brown'}> WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects AND o3 IN objects RETURN count(o3) AS counto3

questions.question: Is the blue block the same size as the green matte ball?

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:cube{size:'large',material:'rubber'}>~[:right]~~<o2{size:'large'}>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 WITH i,objects,o2
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o3:sphere{material:'metal'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 WITH collect( distinct o2) + collect(distinct o3) AS all unwind all as a  RETURN count( distinct a)

 WITH collect( distinct o) + collect(distinct o3) AS all unwind all as a  RETURN count( distinct a)

questions.question: There is a small matte block behind the tiny red object; does it have the same color as the large object?

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects
 MATCH <o{size:'small',color:'red'}>~[:behind]~~<o2:cube{size:'small',material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 MATCH <o3{size:'large'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 RETURN o2.color=o3.color AS same

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects>
 WITH collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:cylinder{color:'gray'}>
 WHERE o IN objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o2{color:'gray'}>
 WHERE o2 IN objects
 RETURN count(DISTINCT o)<count(DISTINCT o2)

questions.question: What number of things are large things on the right side of the big matte block or big objects behind the big matte block?
questions.query: MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:cube{size:'large',material:'rubber'}>~[:right]~~<o2{size:'large'}> WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects WITH i,objects,o2 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o3:cube{size:'large',material:'rubber'}>~[:behind]~~<o4{size:'large'}> WHERE o3 IN objects AND o4 IN objects WITH collect( distinct o2) + collect(distinct o4) AS all unwind all as a  RETURN count( distinct a)

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects
 MATCH <o2:cube{size:'small',color:'gray',material:'rubber'}>~[:left]~~<o3{size:'large',material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o2 IN objects AND o3 IN objects
 MATCH <o{color:'purple',material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o IN objects
 RETURN labels(o3)[0]=labels(o)[0] AS same

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:cylinder{size:'small',color:'gray'}>~[:left]~~<o2>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 WITH i,objects,o2
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o3:cube{color:'red',material:'metal'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 WITH collect( distinct o2) + collect(distinct o3) AS all unwind all as a  RETURN count( distinct a)

 WITH i,objects,o3

 WHERE o IN objects
 WITH collect( distinct o) + collect(distinct o3) AS all unwind all as a  RETURN count( distinct a)

 MATCH <o{size:'large',color:'yellow'}>~[:left]~~<o2:cube{size:'small'}>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 MATCH <o3:sphere{size:'large',material:'metal'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 RETURN o2.color=o3.color AS same

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects>
 WITH collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:cube{size:'small',material:'metal'}>~[:front]~~<o2:cube{size:'small',material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o3:cylinder{size:'large',color:'blue',material:'metal'}>~[:left]~~<o4{material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects AND o4 IN objects
 RETURN count(DISTINCT o2)=count(DISTINCT o4)

questions.question: How many objects are small gray matte cylinders or brown shiny objects?
questions.query: MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:cylinder{size:'small',color:'gray',material:'rubber'}> WHERE o IN objects WITH objects,o OPTIONAL  MATCH <o2{color:'brown',material:'metal'}> WHERE o2 IN objects WITH collect( distinct o) + collect(distinct o2) AS all unwind all as a  RETURN count( distinct a)

questions.question: How many small things are red things or cylinders?

questions.question: What number of objects are gray rubber cylinders that are behind the tiny red cube or small cylinders that are left of the cyan cylinder?

questions.question: How many balls are tiny objects or shiny things?

questions.question: What number of things are tiny shiny things on the left side of the small green ball or brown matte balls?

MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects> WITH i,collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:sphere{size:'small',color:'green'}>~[:left]~~<o2{size:'small',material:'metal'}>
 WHERE o IN objects AND o2 IN objects
 WITH i,objects,o2
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o3:sphere{color:'brown',material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o3 IN objects
 WITH collect( distinct o2) + collect(distinct o3) AS all unwind all as a  RETURN count( distinct a)

questions.question: Are there fewer tiny green cylinders than rubber objects?
questions.query:
MATCH (i)~[:contains]~~<objects>
 WITH collect(objects) AS objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o:cylinder{size:'small',color:'green'}>
 WHERE o IN objects
 OPTIONAL  MATCH <o2{material:'rubber'}>
 WHERE o2 IN objects
 RETURN count(DISTINCT o)<count(DISTINCT o2)
